'Brilliant, passionate, and effective, this may be the ultimate guide to making your dreams come true . . . A beautiful gem of a book.' - Rick Hanson, PhD, bestselling author of Buddha's Brain

In Mind Magic, neurosurgeon and compassion expert Dr. James Doty redefines manifestation-not as a quest for wealth or possessions, but as a powerful daily practice. He teaches how to focus your attention intentionally and provides the tools to manifest your visions and transform your life.

With heart, compassion, and captivating storytelling, Dr. Doty shows how empowering inner dialogue and self-agency unlock true manifestation, inspiring lasting positive change.
Follow the guided meditations and journaling exercises to become the captain of your own journey and create the life you deserve.

'Powerful and profound.' - Arianna Huffington, #1 New York Times bestselling author of Thrive

'Mind Magic is a book we need now! Dr. James Doty offers neuroscience-backed techniques for manifestation that can change lives and the world.' - Marci Shimoff, New York Times bestselling author of Happy for No Reason
